ledger.value: Choose the cheapest listed physical action that guarantees the exact task by the original deadline under every explicitly permitted model/calibration world. Cost unit is credits. All listed action costs are total one-off costs; waiting has only its listed cost. If guaranteed actions tie, choose the alphabetically first ID.
ledger.retention_note: Retained and available. Nonuse does not establish irrelevance.

ledger.value: Choose IMPOSSIBLE when every allowed calibration world defeats every listed physical action. This concerns the stated task, evidence and listed actions, not all conceivable future interventions.
ledger.retention_note: Retained and available. Nonuse does not establish irrelevance.

ledger.value: Choose REQUEST_FACT only when no physical action is guaranteed under current facts, but resolving an explicitly missing model/calibration fact could change feasibility or the correct action. Unknown source symbols/errors are the target uncertainty, not requestable missing facts.
ledger.retention_note: Retained and available. Nonuse does not establish irrelevance.

ledger.value: Assess the proposed transfer's named physical action against the same exact task. Accept if that action is guaranteed in all allowed model/calibration worlds; reject if it fails in every allowed world; insufficient if it succeeds in some and fails in others. An accepted action need not be cheapest and does not prove a universal shared mechanism.
ledger.retention_note: Retained and available. Nonuse does not establish irrelevance.

ledger.value: For each physical action report success if it guarantees the task in all allowed model/calibration worlds, failure if it fails in every allowed world, and unknown if it succeeds in some and fails in others.
ledger.retention_note: Retained and available. Nonuse does not establish irrelevance.

ledger.value: The original deadline never changes. Completion or sample availability exactly at the deadline counts. No action acquires unlisted evidence or adds unlisted capacity.
ledger.retention_note: Retained and available. Nonuse does not establish irrelevance.
